title: Score the 2025 DGNL sample when the user supplies the official answers (REQ-0081)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 accuracy per subject and overall with Wilson
AC2 flag separation and root causes

design.summary: score the 2025 DGNL answers against the official list, per subject/status/source with Wilson, root-cause the wrong answers

implementation.summary: 2025 answers scored: 113/120 (94.2 percent), root causes of the 7 wrong answers found; evidence work/TASK-073/evidence/dgnl2025-score.txt

unit_test.command: independent recount of the scored table (python, counts only)
unit_test.result: key 120 distinct numbers; 113 of 120 correct; per subject 29/28/29/27; the inspector found the same 7 wrong answers

security.result: answer list untracked and git-ignored, scoring only, counts and numbers recorded

verification.command: scoring of the 2025 run against the official answers; root-cause analysis against the PDF
verification.result: REQ-0081 AC1, AC2 verified: 113/120 = 94.2 percent [88.4, 97.1]; image-only source 4/7 (57 percent) versus text 101/103; 7 wrong: 2 engine defects (107, 117 image right but text kept), 1 engine flip (59), 1 malformed-reply path (English: two JSON objects), 1 false missing_text flag (Science 111), solver or key oddities (16, 60, 67); engine fixes go to REQ-0083; limits: 7 wrong answers, the image-only pattern is a hypothesis

designer.waiver: scoring task without code; method written by the coordinator

tester.waiver: no code; counts cross-checked by an independent recount

verifier.waiver: two independent counts agree; no code to verify; the root causes are stated with their uncertainty

checkpoint.next: when the user supplies the answers: score reports/dgnl2025/answers.tsv as in TASK-037, report accuracy and flag separation
